plugins.name: Accounting Schedules
plugins.summary: Adds separate Fixed Assets, Prepaid Expenses, and Deferred Revenue pages with month-end schedules, reviewed imports, and host-controlled journal posting.

releases.releaseNotes: Initial official release of Accounting Schedules with equal-month month-end calculations, opening recognition cutoffs, reviewed CSV/XLSX draft imports, and exact-preview journal posting.

plugins.name: Month-End Bank Cleanup
plugins.summary: Adds three read-only Banking exception reports for pending review, unreconciled confirmed activity, and outflows missing a vendor.

releases.releaseNotes: Initial official catalog release of Month-End Bank Cleanup with three native bank exception reports.

plugins.name: Payroll Journal Assistant
plugins.summary: Imports generic or Gusto general-ledger payroll lines, maps them to SPRK accounts, and posts a reviewed balanced journal.

releases.releaseNotes: Initial official release of Payroll Journal Assistant with reusable account mappings, generic and Gusto-shaped CSV/XLSX inputs, host-owned line review, exact balanced journal preview, and canonical posting.

plugins.name: Invoice Sales Analysis
plugins.summary: Adds invoice-line sales analysis by customer and month, item/SKU, and invoice month without replacing GL income reporting.

releases.releaseNotes: Initial official catalog release of Invoice Sales Analysis with customer trend, item/SKU, and monthly sales reports.
